What these measurements mean

The input and prefill timer describe the prompt processing boundary: time to first returned token also includes scheduling and sampling. The colored model stages are an architecture diagram; this browser runtime does not provide their hidden activations or weight values. The table and matrix use sampled token log probabilities returned by WebLLM. Alternatives are single tokens, not entire possible replies. *Entropy is normalized among the returned top candidates, not the full vocabulary.
